channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Michele Roberts | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Michele Roberts from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Mason Plumlee on Adam Silver, Michele Roberts
item.description:
“People know that we’re playing for the TV at this point. It’s unrealistic to expect any kind of attendance. I know that they’ve talked about cutting down the travel party. I’ve heard proposals of one city, two cities, three cities with 10 teams, an expedited finish to the season or a differentiated version of the playoffs.“I feel like Michele Roberts (executive director of the NBPA) and (Commissioner) Adam Silver are having ongoing discussions and they’re going to do everything they can to get the season back, but not at the expense of anybody’s health or put anybody in a risky situation.”

Mason Plumlee on Adam Silver, Michele Roberts, May 5, 2020. Source: Denver Post.

item.title: Chris Paul on Michele Roberts
item.description:
When the NBPA extended her contract in June 2018, player president Chris Paul tweeted,

“Our goal when we hired Michele was to take back our union. With her leadership and guidance, we have not only accomplished that but we have also established the NBPA as one of the strongest and most active unions in all of professional sports.”

Chris Paul on Michele Roberts, Oct 3, 2019. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Jared Dudley on Michele Roberts
item.description:
Regarding cap smoothing, Jared Dudley on the Woj podcast:

“Michele Roberts is obviously a smart woman. She probably gauged both it ways. She probably talked about it. But, yeah, anytime the league comes to us – or vice versa. If we came to the league about something, they’ll fight back first and then they might let it go through.”

Jared Dudley on Michele Roberts, Jul 27, 2018. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Adam Silver on Michele Roberts
item.description:
“The current age minimum of 19 years old, but something Michele and I discussed directly -- and this is different than last time we negotiated a Collective Bargaining Agreement -- is that rather than say to you that talk to us in seven years when we sit back down to negotiate a new Collective Bargaining Agreement, I think she and I both agree that it's the kind of issue that needs to be studied, in essence, outside of the bright lights of collective bargaining.”

Adam Silver on Michele Roberts, Feb 19, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Adam Silver on Michele Roberts
item.description:
James, Anthony, Dwyane Wade and Chris Paul called for athletes to be more active in promoting social change during the ESPY's earlier this summer.

“I have thought a lot about this, and Michele Roberts and I talked a lot about these issues,”

Adam Silver on Michele Roberts, Oct 21, 2016. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Adam Silver on Chris Paul, Michele Roberts
item.description:
Jordan infamously committed to signing with the Mavericks last summer before deciding to return to the Clippers during the 10-day window.

“I think that is an indication of the level of respect, the level of trust, that we’re building with the Players Association, with Michele Roberts, who’s the relatively new executive director, with Chris Paul, who’s the president of the union, and that was one of those issues where we sat down and we said, both of us, that it truly can be a win-win if we shorten that period,”

Adam Silver on Chris Paul, Michele Roberts, Mar 27, 2016. Source: Boston Globe.

item.title: Adam Silver on Michele Roberts
item.description:
Adam Silver on CBA deal talks with Michele Roberts:

“We continue to talk all the time. I think Michele Roberts and I both have the same goal which is to avoid any sort of work stoppage. And we know one of the ways to avoid a work stoppage is to talk early and often. And we're doing that.”

Adam Silver on Michele Roberts, Oct 7, 2015. Source: Twitter @BarriHoopsHype.
